decision_rule.text: After fresh count six and verification of all six roots, report factorization_verified only if every D4 map row factors. A failed comparison is seed_nonvanishing_witness only if the emitted kernel polynomial is rechecked in the seed and evaluates to one at the listed solution. Any other outcome is failed or unknown. Neither positive nor negative gate alone proves LFD six.

Resource, budget, deadline or lock refusal leaves the named gate unknown.
